{"id":1957607754,"question_id":3031,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"3 months, 4 weeks","timestamp":1774344410,"status":15,"status_display":"Runtime Error","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1957607754/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Construct Product Matrix","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int mod = 12345;\n    \n    vector<vector<int>> constructProductMatrix(vector<vector<int>>& grid) {\n        int n = grid.size();\n        int m = grid[0].size();\n\n        vector<vector<int>>ans;\n        vector<int>vec;\n        vec.resize(n*m , 0);\n\n        int index = 0;\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<n ; i++)\n        {\n            for(int j = 0 ; j<m ; j++) vec[index++] = grid[i][j];\n        }\n\n        int size = vec.size();\n\n        vector<int>prefix(size,1);\n        vector<int>suffix(size,1);\n        vector<int>flatans(size);\n\n        for(int i = 1; i < size; i++) prefix[i] = prefix[i-1] * vec[i-1];\n\n        for(int i = size-2; i >= 0; i--) suffix[i] = suffix[i+1] * vec[i+1];\n\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<size ; i++) flatans[i] = prefix[i] * suffix[i];\n\n        index = 0;\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<n ; i++)\n        {\n            vector<int>temp;\n            for(int k = 0 ; k<m ; k++) temp.push_back(flatans[index++] % mod);\n            ans.push_back(temp);\n        }\n\n        return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"construct-product-matrix","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1857}
